subject: general
question: Which does social networking service place the biggest emphasis on professional networking?
solution:
The correct answer is __**LinkedIn**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LinkedIn** places the biggest emphasis on professional networking.
 
• It is designed specifically for the business community, allowing users to create professional profiles, connect with colleagues, and search for jobs.
 
• LinkedIn also provides a platform for companies to post job openings and for professionals to showcase their skills and experience.
 
• It is widely used for networking, recruiting, and job searching within various industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **LinkedIn** was founded in December 2002 and launched in May 2003.
 
• As of 2021, LinkedIn has over 774 million registered members from more than 200 countries and territories.
 
• LinkedIn also offers premium subscriptions that provide additional features such as enhanced search tools and the ability to send messages to people outside your network.
 
• It is a valuable tool for professionals looking to expand their network, discover job opportunities, and enhance their career development.
